invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null Pair (of partition statistics and global statistics).
The left element (the partitionPathStatMap) of the result pair is a non-null map as constructed in the method.
The right element (the global WorkloadStat) of the result pair is newly constructed and always non-null.
There can be at most as many unique partition paths as input records.
It is expected that the input list is not null (otherwise there would be a NullPointerException at the start).
